notes:
Context: Hatchline is a mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) that ships an in-app assistant + insights feed. They ran a 4-week hosted API trial (dev + staging traf fwd) and now want a Dedicated proposal. Key asks: committed capacity sizing (qps, concurrency, gpu count), detailed cost/latency tradeoffs, and forecasted traffic token mix across chat vs embeddings.

Trial highlights (hosted): p50 gen latency 120ms for gptx-compat small model, p95 420ms under dev concurrency; avg tokens per chat-turn ~340 (user+sys+assist). Embeddings usage 55% of token volume (background batch jobs), reranking spikes seen at end-of-day (EOD job runs). Observed qps distribution: baseline 18 qps, peak burst 95 qps (sustained ~2m), typical concurrency 40-60 concurrent requests during business hours.

POC ask: simulate 1 week of peak-day traffic on Dedicated (including embeddings batch window), validate autoscale from baseline->burst with 90ms p50 SLA target for chat, and show cost delta vs continued Hosted. They asked explicitly: "Can you size for 4x current peak with room for +25% growth?"

Security: must support SSO (SAML), KMS integration for key rotation, audit logs retained 13 months, EU data residency for EU customers. Legal have a short list of questions: data retention by model variant, model artifact provenance. Provided Redwood security FAQ (drive link).

Commercial: willing to commit to 12-month Dedicated if pricing within 60-70% of Hosted predicted spend at scale. CFO flagged procurement approvals around headcount and OPEX vs CAPEX.

Quote / direct from Product lead: "We love the latency but need predictable unit economics before we commit. If Dedicated gives us 40% cost saving on our heavy embedding volume, it's a no-brainer."

Stitch notes we took: shorthand telemetry attached; some event ids referenced in Drive; Fireflies call ff-2026-02-12-9b3f has detailed transcript with concurrency graphs.

Next steps summary: deliver Dedicated sizing spreadsheet (QPS -> GPU mapping, token mix scenarios, concurrency targets), follow-up pricing deck with committed vs burst options, schedule 60-min exec. SE to run load simulation on Dedicated in lab and share logs for fiscal review.

Recent interactions and friction: security review requested a code-of-conduct clause for model finetuning (they do not want host-side tuning), procurement wants clearer exit terms (data deletion SLA), engineering needs sample autoscale policy that won't throttle background batches.
